references.text: The Lord's Spirit came upon Samson with power, so that he tore the lion apart with his bare hands. This shows the same pattern where the Lord's Spirit gives Samson supernatural strength.
The Lord's Spirit came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck down thirty men. The same expression for the Spirit's power coming upon Samson.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Othniel, and he became a judge in Israel. Shows the recurring pattern in Judges where the Lord's Spirit equips leaders with power.
The Lord's Spirit came upon Jephthah. The same wording is used for God's Spirit coming upon judges to give them strength for battle.
God's Spirit came upon Saul with power. A similar description of how God's Spirit seizes people and gives them power.
God's Spirit came upon Saul when he heard this, and he was seized with anger. Shows the same pattern where the Spirit comes upon a person with power.
The Lord's Spirit shall rest upon him. Prophetic text about the Spirit's power resting upon the Messiah, linked to the theme of the Lord's Spirit.
